title: Weighted Grid Pathfinding
description: Implement pathfinding across a grid containing blocked cells and different movement costs.
requirements: The result must contain an ordered path from start to destination.
Blocked cells must never appear in the final path.
Movement cost and estimated remaining cost must be tracked separately.
The system must report when no path exists.
The algorithm must avoid repeatedly recalculating closed nodes without cause.
constraint: Keep the core logic independent from MonoBehaviour so it can be unit tested without a Unity scene.
stretchGoal: Write at least three unit tests covering normal behaviour, an edge case, and invalid input.
